from_notes: Police reorganisation into four commissionerates: Hyderabad, Cyberabad, Malkajgiri (the renamed Rachakonda) and the new Future City.
x: Rachakonda is the old name: the Telangana notification renamed the Rachakonda commissionerate as Malkajgiri, so the four are Hyderabad, Cyberabad, Malkajgiri and the new Future City. The stem has the renaming the wrong way round; Rachakonda is kept as the only option linked to Malkajgiri (its former name), while Future City is the new commissionerate and Cyberabad kept its name.
source: Praveen CA-360 Jan 2026 p.60 ("Rachakonda has been renamed as Malkajgiri, and a new commissionerate named Future City has been created"); Praveen CA-360 Jan 2026 one-liners p.11
dispute: App key: Rachakonda (stem says Malkajgiri was renamed Rachakonda). Strictly: Rachakonda was renamed Malkajgiri (Praveen CA-360 Jan 2026 p.60); Rachakonda is Malkajgiri's former name.
evidence: Praveen CA-360 Jan 2026 p.60: Rachakonda renamed Malkajgiri; Future City new
